title: Prompt injection in AI grading allows students to self-award full marks
impact: Student answers are interpolated with unescaped double quotes into the same user prompt above INSTRUCTIONS in both src/lib/ai/grading.ts and functions/src/grading.ts, allowing a crafted submission to override grading instructions and return score 10.
recommendation: Move grader instructions and rubric into Gemini systemInstruction, isolate student submissions in escaped XML tags, and enforce output structure with generationConfig.responseSchema.

title: billingContext exemption for landing and research suppresses budget errors and allows uncapped Gemini spend
impact: When LANDING_ORG_ID is unset or exhausts its aiBudgetLimit, callGeminiDirect catches and ignores budgetErr for landing/research types; combined with client-generated visitorId strings in /api/chat/landing, attackers can bypass the 10-message demo cap and drain GEMINI_API_KEY without bound.
recommendation: Do not suppress budgetErr when LANDING_ORG_ID hits its budget cap, enforce a server-signed visitor token or App Check on /api/chat/landing, and use a transaction for landing_visitors messageCount.

title: Error swallowing in tutor.ts and synthesizeRubric returns HTTP 200 and persists error strings as AI content or answer keys
impact: explainPhysicsConcept and helpSolveProblem catch all errors and return { text: 'Error: ...' } with HTTP 200, which student/tutor/page.tsx saves into Firestore tutor_sessions; synthesizeRubric returns a fallback string with HTTP 200 that teacher/create/page.tsx writes into question.correctAnswer.
recommendation: Re-throw errors in tutor.ts, synthesizeRubric, and getNavigationResponse so API routes return 4xx/5xx status codes, and never persist error strings into tutor_sessions or question.correctAnswer.

title: Unterminated pending AI budget reservations on transport timeouts permanently leak aiUsageReserved
impact: When fetch times out (60s) or usageMetadata is missing, settleBudget is not called and ai_reservations remains pending forever because no reconciliation job exists, permanently inflating organizations.aiUsageReserved until the network is locked out of AI.
recommendation: Release or settle reservations in a try/finally handler on transport failure, and add a scheduled Cloud Function to expire pending ai_reservations older than 5 minutes.

title: Client-supplied chatHistory and mode in /api/student/tutor allow Socratic constraint bypass and prompt drift
impact: The tutor endpoint trusts client-supplied chatHistory, mode, and role from req.json(), flattens history into plain text where students can spoof Raise assistant turns, and uses STRICT_CONCISE (which omits SOCRATIC_CONSTRAINT and assumes an active assignment) for all non-concept calls.
recommendation: Validate request payloads with zod, pass multi-turn history using native Gemini contents roles with systemInstruction separated, and include SOCRATIC_CONSTRAINT in STRICT_CONCISE.

title: Unreachable string-score parser in grading.ts, destructive // regex in assignment.ts, and zero zod validation on AI JSON
impact: Throwing on typeof data.score !== 'number' at L91 makes the string-score parser ('8/10') at L96 unreachable dead code in both grading files; assignment.ts:L151 strips // comments across entire lines (corrupting URLs in JSON strings); and no AI JSON outputs use zod.
recommendation: Validate all JSON model outputs with zod schemas, run string-score normalization before numeric checks, and remove the line-comment regex in assignment.ts:L151.

title: Hardcoded gemini-3.8-flash model name across 3 files and broken security test after token rate update
impact: Commit 4442694f updated metering.ts rates to Gemini 3.8 Flash (0.45c vs 0.28c) without updating tests/security/workflows.test.ts:L60 (causing npm run test:security to fail), hardcoded gemini-3.8-flash in 3 files, and passed GEMINI_API_KEY in the URL query string in config.ts:L17.
recommendation: Centralize the Gemini model name in an env-backed constant, pass GEMINI_API_KEY via the x-goog-api-key header, and update tests/security/workflows.test.ts:L60 to match getActiveTokenRates().

title: withAuthorizedRequest misclassifies /api/ai/* usage as navigation and Notebook uses 3 conflicting usage counters
impact: withAuthorizedRequest tags /api/ai/generate, /api/ai/parse, and /api/ai/synthesize-rubric as type 'navigation' in billingContext, while notebook chat tracks three separate counters across org and user docs and 8 routes still call the no-op recordUsage() stub.
recommendation: Pass explicit feature types to withAuthorizedRequest for /api/ai/* routes, consolidate notebook usage counters into reserveBudget, and remove the no-op recordUsage() calls.

title: 6 of 9 AI API routes lack rate limiting and checkRateLimit trusts raw x-forwarded-for
impact: student/tutor, ai/parse, ai/synthesize-rubric, grade, chat/limits, and teacher/network/portfolio have no checkRateLimit call, and unauthenticated rate limiting uses raw x-forwarded-for (allowing header spoofing or global bucket sharing under 'unknown-ip').
recommendation: Enforce checkRateLimit across all AI routes and parse a trusted client IP when userId is absent.

title: Unused legacy AI barrel (src/lib/gemini.ts), unused client AI SDK (src/lib/firebase.ts), and dead AI helpers
impact: src/lib/gemini.ts, getGenAIInstance/genAI in src/lib/firebase.ts:L66-L86, getLandingChatbotResponse in chatbot.ts:L47, validateResponse in grading.ts:L172, and repairIncompleteJson in utils.ts:L113 are unused dead code.
recommendation: Remove dead AI files/exports or wire validateResponse and getLandingChatbotResponse into their target routes.
